title: David Grady, “How to save the world (or at least yourself) from bad meetings” (the stolen chair)

meta.charla: How to save the world (or at least yourself) from bad meetings
meta.tema: Trabajo: reuniones que te roban tiempo

lines: Picture this: / It's Monday morning, / you're at the office,
you're settling in for the day of work,
and this guy that you sort of recognize from down the hall
walks right into your cubicle / and he steals your chair.
Doesn't say a word, / just rolls away with it.
Doesn't give you any information / about why he took your chair
out of all of the chairs that are out there.
Doesn't acknowledge the fact / that you might need your chair / to get some work done today.
You wouldn't stand for it. / You'd make a stink.
You'd follow that guy back to his cubicle / and you'd say, “Why my chair?”
Okay, so now it's Tuesday morning, / and you're at the office,
and a meeting invitation pops up in your calendar.
And it's from this woman who you kind of know from down the hall,
and the subject line references some project / you heard a little bit about.
But there's no agenda.
There's no information about why you were invited to the meeting.
And yet you accept the meeting invitation, / and you go.
And when this highly unproductive session is over, / you go back to your desk,
and you stand at your desk and you say, / “Boy, I wish I had those two hours back,
like I wish I had my chair back.”
listen_for: Office English you can reuse: a meeting invitation pops up, no agenda, I wish I had those two hours back · kind of → “kinda”, sort of → “sorta” · parallel structure: Doesn't say… Doesn't give… Doesn't acknowledge…
notas: Subtítulos TED + Whisper small.en. El audio dice «for the day of work» y «out of all of the other chairs»; se sigue el audio. Whisper oye «You follow» (es «You'd follow») y «when you're at the office» (es «and you're»): falsos positivos. Verificación: la segunda pasada de Whisper no oye «that», «from», «of», «and» y oye «projects»/«her»/«when»; la primera pasada y los subtítulos sí coinciden con el texto: falsos positivos revisados (verify --force).
